bounded_interface_domain: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
source_record.native_common_basis: Delegate decisions where local information helps while retaining explicit system, assurance and capacity constraints.
common_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Root literal analytical arguments from the complete selected native bodies and eight executed finite discriminators. One bounded NASA standard corroborates scoped distinctions, not universal authority requirements or causal effect sizes. No new property, field experiment, whole-synthesis completion or independent acceptance.

common_subconditions.P1: The literal common object and actual receiving use exist.

common_subconditions.P3: The separately reasoned partial contribution follows under its actual scope.
common_subconditions.P4: Residual premises, stronger-claim witnesses, alternatives and re-entry remain.

source_record.inference: The named input changes the specified receiving inquiry, capability or decision under its guard. It does not grant another role, certify a whole object, establish causal superiority or create a new implementation requirement.
source_record.common_source_dependence: One scoped NASA primary standard; multiple retrieved passages count once. Existing selected native sources retain their evidence ceilings.

positive_controls.argument: Placing competent decision makers and the explicit delegation near the work supplies an empowered actor and timely local information to the actual change route; out-of-bound effects remain escalations.
The bounded delegation and available competence can supply the actual acceptance actor and local knowledge needed to assess the delivery, while the criterion and exception evidence remain separate.
An explicit team boundary and competencies identify who can prepare or decide the particular certification-related action and when issuer authority must be invoked.

Bounded local decision authority and competence give the challenge team capacity to choose relevant inquiries and escalate findings, contributing to operational independence where the delegation protects those decisions.
The explicit delegation, constraints and competence provide evidence for who can discharge the relevant assurance responsibilities and where an unresolved matter must escalate.
The team's local information and competent authority can select an allowed cheaper control or justified omission without an unnecessary central queue.
Explicit responsibility and available skills identify who can maintain or interpret the relevant model scope and when cross-boundary decisions need escalation.
The bounded delegation and competencies can identify the empowered local risk actor and enable timely use of current operational evidence, with escalation beyond the grant.

receiving_native_meaning.criterion: Its authority, version, semantics, access and reconciliation with actual systems are adequate for the decisions made from it.

member_to_common_premise.actual_object: A delegated engineering decision made from a specifically identified authoritative model.
member_to_common_premise.literal_bridge: Explicit responsibility and available skills identify who can maintain or interpret the relevant model scope and when cross-boundary decisions need escalation.

member_to_premise_evidence.shared_question_or_object: A team's consequential operational choice within an explicit risk-acceptance delegation and operating boundary.

source.bearer: A team decision inside a defined responsibility boundary and with required competencies available.
source.criterion: Delegate decisions where local information helps while retaining explicit system, assurance and capacity constraints.

receiver.bearer: A consequential residual-risk and operational decision
receiver.criterion: An appropriately empowered actor accepts or rejects the stated residual risk with current evidence and a defined operating boundary.

guard: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: The bounded delegation and competencies can identify the empowered local risk actor and enable timely use of current operational evidence, with escalation beyond the grant.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: The bounded delegation and competencies can identify the empowered local risk actor and enable timely use of current operational evidence, with escalation beyond the grant.
premises_supplied: The bounded delegation and competencies can identify the empowered local risk actor and enable timely use of current operational evidence, with escalation beyond the grant.
premises_remaining: An appropriately empowered actor accepts or rejects the stated residual risk with current evidence and a defined operating boundary.
The receiver-native conditions not established by the literal partial contribution, including actual net benefit and any remaining authority or evidence.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: A team authorized to deploy low-risk patches cannot infer permission for a new hazardous operating mode.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: A team authorized to deploy low-risk patches cannot infer permission for a new hazardous operating mode.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: The stated common object or actual receiving use is known absent; if merely unknown, no negative is inferred.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen affected directions on changed responsibilities, delegation, expiry, issuer/basis, configuration, model correspondence, critical knowledge, platform consumers or costs, current evidence, source correction or counterexample. Known absence of this particular common use defeats the guarded instance, not every other possible material use; an unestablished guard is not a global negative.
